market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: No single team has ever entered a Champions League season with a >50% probability to win the title, and PSG is not the dominant force that would justify such odds. Post-Mbappé, they remain a top-10 side but historically underperform in Europe. The market’s 58.5% implied chance is a gross overpricing of YES, given that even elite favourites rarely exceed 20-25% pre-tournament. A fair estimate is around 8% based on competitive landscape and squad depth relative to rivals like Real Madrid, Man City, and Bayern.
evidence_points: No team has a historical pre-season CL win probability above 25-30% due to knockout randomness and competition depth.
PSG lost Mbappé in 2024 and, while they are strong collectively, they lack the singular superstar that historically drove deep runs.
Betting markets for the 2024-25 season implied only ~7.5-10% for PSG, and the 2025-26 outlook is similar.
sources_consulted: Historical Champions League winner odds and implied probabilities
PSG squad composition and transfer activity post-2024
Comparative analysis of European top teams' title chances
